advisories.title: Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Control Expert and Modicon Controllers
advisories.summary: Authentication bypass via Modbus capture-replay in EcoStruxure Control Expert and Modicon M340, M580, Momentum, and MC80 controllers.

advisories.title: Schneider Electric Modicon M580 PLCs, BMENOR2200H, EVLink Pro AC
advisories.summary: Incorrect buffer size calculation allows DoS condition via specially crafted HTTPS packets on Modicon M580 PLCs and BMENOR2200H communication modules.

advisories.title: Rockwell Automation Logix Controllers (ControlLogix, CompactLogix, GuardLogix)
advisories.summary: CRITICAL (CVSS 10.0): Attacker can modify PLC executable program code without detection because readable source logic and compiled bytecode are stored separately. Reported by Claroty.

advisories.title: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 and S7-1200 CPUs Open Redirect
advisories.summary: Open redirect vulnerability in integrated web server of Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 and S7-1200 CPUs.

advisories.title: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 CPUs Information Disclosure
advisories.summary: Unauthenticated attacker can view CPU cycle time and communication load telemetry on SIMATIC S7-1500 CPUs.
